decision.subject: Add F1 Proposed ADR planning work items MPV2-0053..MPV2-0056 (definition class) to masterplan_v2; add dependency edge MPV2-0053→MPV2-0055 for ADR-0714 depends_on ADR-0712
decision.dispatch_state_at_ratification: No masterplan execution wave is recorded as dispatched; the separate pre-planning authority hold remains open.
decision.scope_limit: Planning anchors only. Proposed ADRs ADR-0712..ADR-0715 remain not implement authority. Does not authorize encode, Accept flips, W1+, or execution-wave dispatch. authorizes_execution_wave_dispatch remains false until a separate founder execution-dispatch ratification is recorded.

ratification_authority.basis: Founder-proxy Round-4 decisions for PR #1929 F1 Proposed apex amend (2026-08-10).
ratification_authority.scope_limit: Binds only to the exact sequencing content identified by ratified_sequencing_digest.

digest_recipe: sha256 over canonical JSON (sorted keys, separators ',' ':') of {"dependency_edges": sorted [from, to] pairs from masterplan_v2.dependency_edges, "execution_waves": the work_item_ids arrays of masterplan_v2.sequencing.execution_waves in wave order, "work_item_order": the work_item_id strings of masterplan_v2.sequencing.work_item_order in index order}

derivation.wave_rule: wave(n) = 0 when n has no prerequisite edges; otherwise 1 + max(wave(prerequisite)). Within a wave, work-item ids sort lexicographically; work_item_order is the wave-major concatenation with contiguous zero-based indices.
derivation.note: F1 planning added MPV2-0053→MPV2-0055; W0 k8s-port dependency topology otherwise unchanged.
